senses.gloss: The twenty-first consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, corresponding to the letter P.

m. (पः)
1 Air, wind.
2 A prince, a ruler.
3 A leaf.
4 Drinking.
E.
पा to nourish, &c. aff. ड.

r. 1st cl. (पिवति)
To drink.
r. 2nd cl. (पाति)
To cherish, to nourish, to protect or preserve.

mfn. (-पाः-पाः-पं)
1 Who drinks.
2 Who protects or cherishes.
E.
पा to drink, &c. क्विप् aff.
